body:
I got a cold last week, but had purchased 10 hits of e so that I could have some fun throughout the next few months.  I wanted to have some fun this past friday night, but this damn cold kept me home.  Its sunday. Last night, I said 'wtf, I might as well see if it is any good, see how strong it is.'  So I took half a pill. Within the hour, my ears were clearing, my sinuses emptied and I could breathe normally.  So then I took the other half crushed in water.  The effects weren't as strong as I have previously experienced with e (might be the cold) but I managed to get 6 hours of sinus headache relief and didn't have to blow my nose until I went to bed at around 1am.  Clearly its not a medical trial, but hey, why not have some fun when you have a cold.
